doc.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Auditioning for Dick Stabile in Pittsburgh
summary: He auditioned with 'Confessing' and had to buy a trumpet to join Stabile.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band
